summary: Lachlan Giles’s No Gi Open Guard Volume 1: K Guard develops entries, leg attacks and responses to common counters.
description: K-guard offense against kneeling, combat-base and standing opponents, including backside 50/50 and X-guard options.
overview: No Gi Open Guard Volume 1: K Guard places K guard within Lachlan Giles’s wider open-guard approach. It covers entries against different opponent postures and from retention situations, then develops offense through backside 50/50, X guard and other positions. The course contains eight parts, including troubleshooting and narrated rolling.

guide.display_title: Lachlan Giles: K-Guard Entries and Offense

fits: You want a detailed no-gi K-guard course with entries, leg entanglements and offensive follow-ups.

includes: K-guard positioning and entries against kneeling, combat-base and standing opponents.
Retention entries, backside-50/50 heel-hook attacks, X-guard options and counter responses.
limits: Leg entanglements and heel-hook offense form a substantial part of the course; its scope goes well beyond learning a single guard entry.
